title: Vulkanite
description: A mod that brings hardware accelerated raytracing to minecraft java edition
body:
Vulkanite is a mod that enables shaders to use hardware raytracing (RT cores) to render minecraft (the same technology used in minecraft RTX bedrock edition)

# WARNING
This mod is very very early in development and highly unstable and uses alot of vram, there are many issues, do not use it with normal gameplay

# Compatibility
Nvidia gpus RTX and up, older gpus that have software rt pipeline, may work may not, it is untested and support will be improved over time.

AMD the drivers 22.7.1 and up do not support opengl vulkan interop.

Intel arc support is unknown and untested.
